clips.title: The story
paras: Keeper Bel'varil is a Forsaken caretaker and researcher stationed at Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Working closely alongside Wordeen Voidglare, he directs Horde adventurers to gather magical relics and binding materials from the surrounding lands to further their occult studies.

Amid the besieged village of Tarren Mill, Keeper Bel'varil quietly supports the Forsaken's magical and alchemical research. While royal apothecaries and soldiers occupy themselves with the Alliance garrison down the road at Southshore, Bel'varil focuses on practical sorcery, dispatching travelers to recover stone tokens and binding bracers from nearby elemental and enchanted threats.
